density: Full 2020 block population divided by full Census AREALAND. City-clipped border polygons flagged; population is not allocated to city fragments. Zero land area is unknown.
context: ACS estimates and 90% margins of error belong to whole 2024 block groups (disability: Census tracts), including portions outside city; displayed geometry clipped for scope only. No block-level demographic/price inference.
affordability: Median gross rent and owner-reported median home value, not current listings, transactions, appraisals or individual prices.
comparison: Daily-place access score averaged over housing-positive blocks with snap<=100m; comparisons require >=5 such blocks per 2024 block group. Descriptive, ecological, unweighted across block origins, not causal or individual inference.
